name: g9-battle-sample
description: Wild battles of 10%/2%/1% bands to 'doubles'/'triples'/'hordes' and a 0.5% 'bossFight' band (x1-x5 max HP, random boss protections). Every 2+-mon trainer battle routes to 'doubles', the Elite Four roll doubles-or-triples, and the Champion and Red route to 'bossFight'. Options add a trainer difficulty preset (easy/normal/hard/hell) and two toggles -- RAND WILDS and RAND TRAINER MONS -- which re-roll species to type-matching, BST-equivalent ones from the registered national dex
